# MMG App Icon Guide

**Icons are generated by PowerShell script using real logo PNG files. Never hand-draw or approximate them in SVG.**

## How to generate icons

```powershell
cd C:\Users\andyg\Desktop\cursor\mmg-tools
.\scripts\generate-pwa-icons.ps1           # all apps except internal
.\scripts\generate-internal-pwa-icon.ps1   # internal only
```

Outputs `icon-512.png`, `icon-192.png`, `apple-touch-icon.png` into each app's `icons/` folder.

## What each icon looks like

- Solid brand-colour background (OS applies the rounded corners)
- Real MMG circular logo PNG centred in the upper portion
- App name in Cormorant Infant Bold (Georgia fallback), centred below logo
- Gold bar (`#B8973C`) pinned to the bottom

## Logo file to use per background type

| Background | Logo file |
|---|---|
| Dark (pine, navy, burgundy, black) | `MMG_Logo_White_Transparent.png` |
| Near-black | `MMG_Logo_Grey_Transparent.png` |
| Light (cream) | `MMG_Logo_Green_Transparent.png` |
| Yellow / warm light | `MMG_Logo_Black_Transparent.png` |

Logo files are in `C:\Users\andyg\My Drive\Mr Mallorca Golf\Logos and Signature\` and mirrored in `mrmallorcagolf-real\public\`.

## Adding a new app

Add an entry to `$apps` in `mmg-tools/scripts/generate-pwa-icons.ps1`, run the script, done. Full instructions in `mmg-tools/APPS.md`.
